title: xDrip+ Does not ask for the sensor insertion time - I have to wait the full warmup time
symptom: When starting an already started Dexcom G6 sensor session in xDrip+, xDrip+ does not ask for the sensor insertion time and forces a full 2-hour warmup before showing glucose values, even though it receives and broadcasts glucose data to other apps like AndroidAPS.
cause: The request for insertion time was removed from Native-mode G6 intentionally because you cannot enter any time other than now when you start a G6 sensor. Also, you cannot do soaking with Native G6 because it would interfere with factory calibration.
fix: Do not press 'Start Sensor' if you have an active session; just establish connectivity and readings will start showing. If everything is set up correctly, xDrip will pick up a session in progress in 10 to 15 minutes.
evidence_quote: You don't need to "start" if you have an active session. All you need to do is to establish connectivity and the readings will start showing.
